integrity: Complete standalone mathematical proof and Python 3 verifier; finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. No claim of independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes p and exponents e>=2. The image polynomial counts retractions with multiplicity as maps, not distinct isomorphism types of retract images. General endomorphism parameterization is prior work. The 2026 cited thesis was not accessible; historical priority is not independently established.
title: Retraction-size spectrum of odd-prime modular multiplicative monoids
